notes.title: Graphical Overhaul
notes.content:
Hello dear Tank Operations players,

Christmas is near and we are all taking a little rest. A special year is coming to an end, not only because of the extraordinary situation this pandemic is putting us all into, but also for Linked Dimensions and Tank Operations. A lot has happened behind the scenes. Before we wish you relaxing Christmas holidays, we would like to share some great news with you and make you curious about the new year.

Tank Operations gets a whole new look! We have evaluated feedback from the past and considered other factors. Therefore, graphically, hardly anything remains the same. You may look forward to the following:

- complete revision of all units in terms of color scheme and level of detail
- graphic realignment of all levels
- completely redesigned UI
- generally a more realistic and contemporary look
- compatibility with higher resolutions than full HD

We have added links to some before-and-after comparisons of units and a level to this news. We hope you enjoy it and we look forward to your feedback.

New tank - M26 Pershing

notes.title: Early Adopter Version 2.0.1.0
notes.content:
Dear players,

We uploaded a new version to the early adopter branch and it has a brand new bonus level: "Fortress Metz". It's just the start of a whole series of bonus levels. After early access, the bonus levels are unlocked as soon as players have finished a certain part of the campaign, usually levels taking place in one country. For example, after having finished Italy, a bonus level for Italy is unlocked. These bonus levels give insight to other historical events to support the atmosphere of the game. During early access, all bonus levels can be played as soon as they are released.

With the "Radar Station" we also introduced a new unit. Other than that we tweaked the balancing a little and fixed some bugs. Here's the complete list:

Levels
added new bonus level: Fortress Metz

Units
Added new unit "Radar Station"
Added Radar Station to levels 8-12
New special skill "Radar Impulse" for Radar Station
Commando Bunker has new skill "Ground Radar"

Balancing
Reduced weapon range of Sturmtiger to 6
Reduced maximum damage for Sturmtiger to 1050
Reduced maximum damage for Sturmpanzer IV to 750
Reduced capacity of Transport Trucks to 3
Increased hit probability for bombs
Increase maximum damage for the BF110's bombs
Reduce the damage of the He 177's bomb attack of the He177

Bug fixes
Units are no longer available twice when ordering reinforcement
No more tooltips shown when cursor is outside the window
AI saboteur doesn't stop capturing a building
Landing strips no longer built on inaccessible terrain

Have fun with the new update and as always, write us your opinion.

Yours Team of Linked Dimensions

notes.title: Early Adopter Branch
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we had announced it some time ago but finally the "early adopter" branch has arrvied.

[b]What is the "early adopter branch"?[/b]
In this branch you will find features that are not quite finished yet/a little rough around the edges, so we don't want to integrate them into the "main" branch yet. But we'd still like to hear your feedback on them. Later on we'll also have ai tweaks here for you to check out.

But beware as mentioned above these features are not quite done yet so the version might be a little more buggy or unstable! But if you are curious and would like to share your thoughts this should be something for you.


[b]How do I get this branch?[/b]
Go to your steam library, right click on Tank Operations: European Campaign and select "Properties".
In the window that opens click on "BETAS" and under "Select the beta..." select the "early_adopter" branch. If you would like to goback to the normal version, select "NONE".

[b]Where do I report bugs[/b]
You report bugs just as you'd do with the normal version, throught the bug tracker form. If you have a crash dump you can send it to support@linked-dimensions.de


We are looking forward to you feedback

notes.title: Final Countdown: Early Access starts August 8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33437603/9a5a913ce58a88e1aae0dcec11279f124886e170.png[/img]
Hi strategy fans,

We are thrilled to announce that [i]Tank Operations: European Campaign Remastered[/i] Early Access starts [b]August 8[/b]!

We can hardly wait to welcome you to lead nerve-wracking battles against the Wehrmacht and to smash the threat to Europe by the destructive forces of the Third German Reich.

We hope Early Access will give us the feedback we need to make the game an amazing experience for strategists and tacticians alike for years to come. We know that you may still have questions. We have highlighted some key points below to help you navigate Early Access and beyond! 

[b]What is included in Early Access?[/b]
Early Access offers you an early entry into [i]Tank Operations: European Campaign Remastered[/i]. On release day you will be able to play the first 4 levels of the game. We want to work on one level after the other step by step. We intend to release regular content updates until we reach v1.0. You can already expect a lot of fun despite the rough edges, lack of balance, possible bugs and missing content which are typical for Early Access games. You'll be part of an ongoing development of a game that is still in test mode.  

[b]When is the game's Early Access launching?[/b]
Tank Operations Early Access will be launching August 8.

[b]What languages will be supported?[/b]
At launch, Tank Operations Early Access will be in English, French, German, Polish, Russian and Simplified Chinese. With your help we want to find out into which other languages the game has to be translated.

[b]How do I participate in Tank Operations Early Access?[/b]
That's an easy one! You'll be able to purchase the Early Access version on Steam on August 8th.

[b]If I buy the Early Access version, does that mean I get access to the full version of the game when it's releases, without paying any extra / twice?[/b]
Early Access is intended for fans of strategy games who will participate and contribute to Tank Operations Early Access and in return, will have the full version of the game upon release.

[b]... and when will that be?[/b]
We estimate that [i]Tank Operations: European Campaign [/i]will be in Early Access for about 4 to 6 months.

[b]How will I be involved in the develpment process?[/b]
If you purchase Tank Operations on Early Access, you will have the chance to play the game and become an active part by providing valuable feedback to us and help us improve and finalize the game. Getting feedback from the community is the reason why we are going through Early Access! Whether it’s bug reports, ideas or general criticism, we appreciate your feedback on the Steam discussion board.

[b]How can I stay up-to-date on everything regarding Early Access?[/b]
We’ll update you on all new things that will happen! Just keep an eye on Steam and our feedback forum. 

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]
Tank Operations Early Access will be released with a discount. With the release of version 1.0, the price will increase.

[b]Please note: All players who have the "old" Tank Operations in their Steam library will automatically receive the new full version free of charge as soon as it is available.[/b]
